faqs.question: What research methodologies do you use at Smartbyte Ltd.?
faqs.answer: We combine quantitative primary research (surveys, statistical modeling) and secondary market audits (industry databases, regulatory filings, competitor benchmarking) to deliver verified, actionable intelligence.

faqs.question: How long does a standard market feasibility report take?
faqs.answer: Standard feasibility studies typically take 2 to 3 weeks depending on market scope. Accelerated 7-day competitive intelligence deep dives are also available for urgent decision-making.

faqs.question: Can research reports be customized for specific niche industries?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every report is tailored to your target sector—including SaaS, FinTech, E-Commerce, Retail, and HealthTech—with customized metrics matching your business goals.

faqs.question: How is client data and proprietary strategy kept confidential?
faqs.answer: All consultations and project data are protected under strict Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs). Your strategic plans and research outcomes remain 100% confidential.
